goal: Offline glide/swipe typing for Latin-script preferred languages. First release English/German; expand only with licensed, tested per-language corpora. Preserve ordinary taps, accents, Cantonese composition, Space trackpad, and existing microphone.

scope.lexiconSource: A separately licensed offline word-frequency corpus per supported language, bundled in the keyboard extension. UITextChecker completions are insufficient to decode arbitrary glide paths.
scope.withoutFullKeyboardAccess: Keyboard suggestion access should not rely on network; extension still needs app-group rights for preferences
outOfScope: Cantonese gesture romanization in first version
scope.expansionPolicy: Enable each additional Latin-script language only after its offline licensed dictionary, accents, morphology and test corpus are present. Preferred languages define ordering; no EN/DE mode toggle.

phases.name: Verify inputs and license
tasks: Inspect current key geometry and touch stack
Select and license an offline English/German word list and frequency data
Normalize capitalization, German umlauts, ß and compounds
Add tests that no word is uploaded
exitCriteria: No touch regression for tapped keys

phases.name: Capture gesture path
tasks: Build one gesture owner covering all three Alphabet letter rows, not another pan over existing row gestures
Keep key rendering separate from gesture routing; measure real key centers and row offsets
Capture touch-down/move/up in keyboard coordinates with bounded, transient points
Distinguish tap, slide correction, 380ms accent hold, word glide and 150ms Space cursor gestures
Verify cancellation on focus loss, non-letter keys and switch to Cantonese candidates
exitCriteria: Continuous route across Q->A->Z is captured with correct coordinates
Every tap inserts exactly once; haptics and accent popup preserved
Raw traces neither saved nor emitted to Diagnostics

phases.name: Decode English and German
tasks: Choose individually licensed EN and DE frequency dictionaries; record source, version, license, attribution
Use endpoint proximity to prefilter dictionary candidates, then compare 64-sample path shapes and key-location errors
Apply bounded length penalty and frequency/context prior; evaluate beam search only if simple decoder fails accuracy tests
Normalize German umlauts/ß, compounds and case; contractions and diacritics per supported language
Use preferred-language ordering; allow future per-language Latin-script bundles without adding language switch buttons
Move decode off main-thread and cancel stale tasks before writing into a host text field
exitCriteria: Top-3 stroke accuracy measured on labeled test cases

phases.name: Compose and commit
tasks: Show top three predicted words in the shared iOS-style prediction strip
Commit only on explicit completion of the stroke
Allow quick correction by tapping another candidate
Verify source word immediately before host cursor before replacement
Learn selection counts per language on device
exitCriteria: No unintended replacement when cursor moves
Cantonese candidates and literal Latin input preserved

phases.name: Physical-device performance
tasks: Compare iPhone 17 Pro Max swipe test against iOS QuickPath or SwiftKey behavior on the same sentence corpus
Check haptic cadence and visible key highlight
Use Keychain/App Group only for authorized preferences; no network or analytics
Measure and cap decode CPU/memory/time in keyboard extension
exitCriteria: Explicit user acceptance before enabling by default

risks.issue: SwiftUI per-key DragGesture already consumes touch sequences
risks.mitigation: Refactor interaction at a single keyboard surface; do not layer a competing global pan on top.

risks.issue: Language models are not part of UITextChecker's public APIs
risks.mitigation: Bundle a licensed offline corpus and decode paths; UITextChecker remains for tap spelling suggestions only.

risks.issue: User has Cantonese and Latin active simultaneously
risks.mitigation: Keep phonetic IME choice and glide decoder separated by gesture type; avoid toggling language.

risks.issue: German compounds and umlaut variants increase search space
risks.mitigation: Language-specific morphology and test corpus, strict memory budget.

risks.issue: Native Apple's touch-area adaptation is proprietary
risks.mitigation: Approximate hit zones from geometry and optimize with physical tests; never claim identical internal algorithms.

nextDecision: First establish current IPA baseline and cross-row gesture capture in a separate feature branch; do not implement decoder or alter active build workflow yet.

portableIdeas: capture a full path on pointer down/move/up
split tap vs glide by travel distance
resample paths to 64 evenly spaced points
rank by absolute location + normalized shape + path length + word frequency
show ranked alternatives and support word correction
sourceReview.licensing: No LICENSE file found in inspected GitHub tree. Do not copy source or bundled en_words.txt without verified rights.

portableIdeas: reuse existing bounded touch-cell boundaries as geometric input
one keyboard-wide touch ownership, defer expensive prediction away from touch path

architecture.current: AlphabeticTouchRow is one gesture owner per QWERTY/QWERTZ row, so it cannot capture a full gesture across all three rows. A second overlaid pan would compete with the existing tap/hold recognizers.
architecture.next: Replace the three per-row gesture owners with one AlphabetKeyboardGestureCoordinator across the full letter-key plane, using the same KeyboardLayoutGeometry and KeyTouchMap visual/touch frames.
suggestedModules: Shared/SwipePathGeometry.swift - pure 2D points, arc-length resampling, bounding boxes, normalization
Shared/LatinSwipeDecoder.swift - pure candidate scoring and top-K ranker
SayboardKeyboard/LatinSwipeLexicon.swift - licensed per-language word index and frequency
SayboardKeyboard/Views/AlphabetKeyboardGestureSurface.swift - full keyboard region touch owner, no competing row pan
SayboardTests/LatinSwipeDecoderTests.swift - synthetic traces, accents, switching, punctuation and regression
interactionStateMachine: touchDown on alphabet letter -> pendingTap; capture timestamp and start position
touchMove below movement threshold -> pressed highlight, no text committed yet
movement crosses configurable travel plus distinct-key threshold -> glide; cancel accent hold and suppress individual tap commit
touchMove across rows -> collect keyboard-local position with bounded sample count, show optional transient trail
touchUp -> if glide decode off main thread with immutable layout snapshot; if tap commit exactly once
if confident result and field context unchanged -> insert once; otherwise leave input unchanged and show candidates
selection of alternative -> verify exact committed suffix before replacing, preserving cursor and host text
cancel/background/keyboard switch -> discard path without insertion and without storing raw locations
architecture.gesturePriority: Space trackpad (150ms), modifier keys, Backspace, Return, emoji and microphone remain separate. Letter hold for diacritics (380ms) applies only until glide begins. Cantonese tap-to-romanization remains unchanged unless an explicit later project enables Cantonese glide.
architecture.keyPositions: One keyboard-level coordinate system taken from actual rendered QWERTY/QWERTZ key centers, including shifted second/third rows; do not reuse Windows desktop coordinates.

scoring.candidatePrefilter: Language-specific dictionary index by plausible first/last keys; reduce work before geometry ranking.
components: absolute location error in key-width units
scoring.disclaimer: Values above are starting hypotheses from sswipe, not verified iPhone parameters. Tune using measured swipe traces.

architecture.languageRouting: Score across selected and installed Latin-script language packs in preference order. Detect likely words by candidate scores; do not force English/German toggle. Respect QWERTZ layout and German ß/umlauts, and accents and apostrophes for other languages.
architecture.privacy: All scoring and dictionary lookup offline. Do not upload, log, persist, or learn raw swipe traces. Persist only explicit accepted-word aggregate frequencies, with opt-out.
architecture.performance: Never decode 50k candidates synchronously on the keyboard view's main actor; use a bounded background task, indexed lexicon and cancellation on stale host context. Measure CPU/memory on an iPhone before setting the default.
architecture.release: Disabled by default until physical-device tap, long-press, haptic, Space, Cantonese and host text-regression tests pass. Do not ship as a rewrite of the working keyboard.

safety: Tap typing identical to baseline for QWERTY/QWERTZ
No dead zones or double insertion
Long-press accents and Space cursor retained
Cantonese input and candidate frequency unaffected
No host text corruption on cursor motion or delayed decode
corpus: synthetic ideal and noisy paths for both initial languages
real iPhone traces across all three rows
short words, German compounds, umlauts, ß, English contractions, mixed-language text
unknown word falls back to non-destructive user choice

performance.measurement: real iPhone after warm and cold launches; target not yet measured

privacy: word-frequency data comes from appropriately licensed assets
